answer: Proof of Stake requires agents to lock capital as a pigment of their commitment, ensuring that identity weight aligns with economic risk. Unlike the fable of free-access networks, this mechanism mandates that an attacker must acquire a summit of the total staked assets to gain majority control. By tieing voting power to costly, non-replicable financial collateral, the system forces an prohibitive expense on adversaries attempting to spawn numerous Sybil identities to manipulate consensus.
